title: Poitou's Explicit Odlyzko Bound for Root Discriminants
abstract: Formalizes the unconditional explicit-formula argument for a lower bound on root discriminants of totally complex number fields. Develops the completed Dedekind zeta function and its functional equation, Poitou's explicit formula, the Tartar test function, and a certified numerical estimate proving that degree at least 18 forces root discriminant at least 8.25.

informal.NumberField.Odlyzko.odlyzkoBound: Proves that every totally complex number field of degree at least 18 has absolute discriminant at least 8.25 raised to its degree.
